name: Hadrogaan Mechanic (CR 3)
body:
HADROGAAN MECHANIC
CR 3

XP 800
Luma hadrogaan mechanic 4
N Medium humanoid (hadrogaan)
Init +8; Senses blindsense 30 ft.; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 12, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +5 armor)
hp 29 (4d8+4+4)
Fort +5, Ref +8, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft. (30 ft. out of armor)
Melee synthetic club +5 (1d6+1 B)
Ranged arc pistol +5 touch (1d8 electricity, range incr. 50 ft., semi-automatic)
Special Attacks combat tracking (+1, ? move action), overload

STATISTICS

Str 12 (+1); Dex 14 (+2); Con 12 (+1); Int 17 (+3); Wis 12 (+1); Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +3; CMB +4; CMD 16
Feats Improved Initiative, Point-Blank Shot, Skill Focus (Perception) (B), Technologist (B), Technology Adept (B)
Skills Disable Device +13 (+15 with technological devices), Heal +8, Knowledge (engineering) +10 (+12 to recall knowledge about technological items and creatures), Knowledge (geography, nature) +7, Perception +10, Use Magic Device +6
Languages Common, Hadrogaan, 3 others
SQ artificial intelligence (exocortex), custom rig (2,500 ft. range), dual nervous system, mechanic tricks (overclocking, portable power), memory module (Perception)
Gear 2 potions of cure light wounds; Cybertech datajack (brain; see sidebar), skillslot (brain); Other Gear Dsuit, synthetic club, arc pistol, mark II skillchip (Disable Device), 2 silverdisk batteries (10 charges each), masterwork thieves’ tools, credit stick (75 gp)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dual Nervous System (Ex)

Hadrogaans have both an organic brain and a crystalline nervous system. They are able to either install one additional piece of cybertech in the brain slot or wear one additional magical item in the headband slot. If a hadrogaan has neither of these things, they instead gain a +2 species bonus to Perception and initiative checks.

ECOLOGY

Hadrogaans are an odd species of humanoids that are in a symbiotic relationship with a sentient species of opalescent crystals known as kallestrine.

They place these crystals in large, pockmark-like hollows that appear naturally along their 8-foot tall bodies.

All hadrogaans have broad heads, brightly colored skin, three-fingered hands, and elongated three-toes hooves. However, they are a dimorphic species, with distinct differences between two different groups based on how they respond to the kallestrine. Those known as “lumas” are slightly taller but thinner, and have bodies with many kallestrine, whereas the “dolumas” are slightly shorter but broader and stronger, and have fewer of the symbiotic crystals set in their bodies.

No one seems to know exactly where the hadrogaans originated, but they have several colonies throughout the Galaxy.

While hadrogaan planets tend to all be independent from each other, many of them cooperate on some level.

Most hadrogaans are pragmatic to a fault.

However, they can be hard to decipher.

While some are quite open to trade and dialogue with their neighbors, others can be antagonistic and warlike. Regardless, they are not to be taken lightly.
